'''Gehn's Overlook''' was an outpost of the [[Voss commandos]] in the [[Nightmare Lands]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] that was used as a base by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The name came from the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Murbek Gehn]], who resided in a building atop a rocky spire next to the main outpost in the [[Crysfang Glade]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gehn's Overlook appears as the Imperial base in the Nightmare Lands on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The spelling of "Gehn" varies between the maps, mission logs, and other in-game text, with some instances spelling it "Ghen."<ref name="TOR" />
